description: VMware 单台虚拟机钻取详情（vmware-exporter 当前指标命名）：基本信息、CPU/内存压力、按网卡网络、按数据存储磁盘吞吐/延迟/IOPS。

targets.expr: max by(vmwcluster)(vmware_cluster_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(cmo) max by(cmo)(vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(hostmo) max by(hostmo)(vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"})))

panels.title: CPU 与内存趋势 · CPU & Memory Trends
CPU 使用率 · 延迟 · 就绪 · Usage / Latency / Ready

targets.expr: label_set(100 * sum(vmware_vm_cpu_usage_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}) / (sum(vmware_host_cpu_capacity_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} * on(hostmo) group_left() max by(hostmo)(vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"})) * sum(vmware_vm_cpu_corecount{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"})),"m","使用率 Usage") or label_set(100 * vmware_vm_cpu_latency_ratio{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"},"m","调度延迟 Latency") or label_set(100 * vmware_vm_cpu_readiness_ratio{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"},"m","就绪 Ready")

panels.title: CPU 使用 / 需求 / 授权 · Used / Demand / Entitled

targets.expr: label_set(sum(vmware_vm_cpu_usage_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","已用 Used") or label_set(sum(vmware_vm_cpu_demand_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","需求 Demand") or label_set(sum(vmware_vm_cpu_entitlement_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","授权 Entitled")

panels.title: 内存占比 · 已分配/活动/授权/共享

targets.expr: label_set(100 * sum(vmware_vm_mem_consumed_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}) / sum(vmware_vm_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","已分配 Consumed") or label_set(100 * sum(vmware_vm_mem_active_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}) / sum(vmware_vm_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","活动 Active") or label_set(100 * sum(vmware_vm_mem_entitlement_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}) / sum(vmware_vm_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","授权 Entitled") or label_set(100 * sum(vmware_vm_mem_shared_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}) / sum(vmware_vm_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","共享 Shared")

panels.title: 内存压力 · 膨胀与交换 Balloon & Swap

targets.expr: label_set(sum(vmware_vm_mem_balloon_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","膨胀 Balloon(vmmemctl)") or label_set(sum(vmware_vm_mem_swapped_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","交换 Swapped") or label_set(sum(vmware_vm_mem_active_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"}),"m","活动 Active")

panels.title: 各虚拟网卡吞吐 · Per vNIC

targets.expr: label_set(label_replace(sum by(pfinstance)(vmware_vm_net_receive_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo",pfinstance=~"vmnic.*"}),"nic","vNIC$1","pfinstance","vmnic([0-9]+)$"),"dir","接收 Rx") or label_set(label_replace(sum by(pfinstance)(vmware_vm_net_transmit_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo",pfinstance=~"vmnic.*"}),"nic","vNIC$1","pfinstance","vmnic([0-9]+)$"),"dir","发送 Tx")

label_set(1000 * (sum by(ds)(vmware_vm_datastore_read_latency_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"} * on(pfinstance) group_left(ds) max by(pfinstance,ds)(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"}))),"rw","读") or label_set(1000 * (sum by(ds)(vmware_vm_datastore_write_latency_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"} * on(pfinstance) group_left(ds) max by(pfinstance,ds)(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"}))),"rw","写")

label_set(sum by(ds)(vmware_vm_datastore_read_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"} * on(pfinstance) group_left(ds) max by(pfinstance,ds)(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"})),"rw","读") or label_set(sum by(ds)(vmware_vm_datastore_write_bytes_per_second{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"} * on(pfinstance) group_left(ds) max by(pfinstance,ds)(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"})),"rw","写")

label_set(sum by(ds)(vmware_vm_datastore_read_operations{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"} * on(pfinstance) group_left(ds) max by(pfinstance,ds)(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"})),"rw","读") or label_set(sum by(ds)(vmware_vm_datastore_write_operations{vcenter=~"$vcenter",vmmo=~"$vmmo"} * on(pfinstance) group_left(ds) max by(pfinstance,ds)(vmware_datastore_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter"})),"rw","写")
